name: AI Input Box

semanticTypeCandidates.evidence: Reverse-engineered from Light Mode screenshots (Screens 1, 6, 7): large multi-line textarea with model selector, attachment support, and send button. This is the primary interaction component for AI-powered workflows.

variantDimensions.name: size-state-density
variantDimensions.evidence: Inferred from screenshots: multi-line textarea (~72px default, expands with content), control row with attachment + model selector + send button.

representativeVariants.whySelected: Root container for AI multi-modal input. Contains textarea + control row.
Focus state with brand-colored border and subtle elevation.
Circular brand-colored send button at end of control row.

structurePatterns: Two vertically stacked regions: textarea (top) + control row (bottom).
Textarea: full-width, multi-line, auto-growing, with AI-optimized placeholder text.
Control row: left-aligned attachment icon + model selector dropdown; right-aligned send button.
Model selector shows current model name (e.g., 'Seed-Code') with dropdown arrow.
Send button: circular, brand-colored, with paper-plane icon.
Attachment button: icon-only, 28px, subtle hover background.
Placeholder text: instructional AI-focused copy (not generic 'Type here').
Keyboard: Enter to send (single line), Shift+Enter for newline.
usageHints: Use as the primary user input in AI-powered IDE and workspace surfaces.
Always include model selector — model choice is a core user decision point.
Support file attachments via the attachment button.
Placeholder text should guide users toward AI-optimized prompting.
Textarea should auto-grow up to 300px, then scroll internally.
doNotInvent: Do not replace with a standard textarea — the AI context (model selector, attachment) is essential.
Do not remove the model selector — it differentiates AI input from standard input.
Do not make the send button non-circular — circular shape is a visual affordance for 'send'.
Do not use generic placeholder text — AI-focused guidance is part of the UX.
unknowns: Exact list of models available in selector not confirmed.
Streaming response behavior (typing indicator, cancellation) not shown.
Voice input integration not visible in screenshots.
Rate limiting / error states not visible.
